answer: Stake bonds at the basalt: each identity locks 10k tokens, slashable on proof of duplicate control. A sybil farm must bond 10k per fake node, so 100 identities demand 1M in collateral—capital that cannot wander across chains or dune-dodge detection once a challenger flags shared infrastructure. Slashing burns 100% on verified collusion. Cost scales linearly with attacker footprint while honest nodes risk only their own stake. This works because faking identities is no longer free; every additional sybil multiplies locked, forfeitable capital, making large-scale attacks economically irrational.
